header: How Northwind runs five brands on one install

client_logo.description: Fictional demo brand from the Desiderio styleguide.

description:
Northwind's agency moved five brand sites into one TYPO3 v14 install. Each page tree has its own theme preset: Marine for logistics, Gold for the holding company and Bloom for careers. One page property sets the preset, and subpages inherit it. The maintainers did the €890 installation and reviewed the presets under the Agency plan. The relaunch took six weeks.
When a brand changes its look, nothing needs rebuilding.
